limitations: All six rows are paired synthetic evidence-ablation controls derived from six previously tested positive cases, not six naturally sampled source passages.
Two CARE III controls share the same document cluster, so there are six nodes from five source clusters.
The FAA source is cancelled/superseded and is included only as a historical text-classification control, not current maintenance guidance.
The paired original decisive quote is withheld from model input but remains in the separate original fixture and source documents; model pretraining exposure cannot be ruled out.
Labels are AI-assigned from the evidence shown to the model before inference, not human expert Gold or independent second-agent review.

This probe tests abstention when gate wording is absent from the supplied scope; it does not estimate natural-distribution accuracy, calibrate confidence, or validate source extraction, cause completeness, recursive FTA generation, database integration, or production readiness.
